stemMd: What role does the fourth paragraph play?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It rejects every measurement reported earlier.

options.label: B
options.textMd: It provides a historical account of the invention of sound meters.

options.label: C
options.textMd: It proves that volunteer selection cannot affect any results.

options.label: D
options.textMd: It qualifies the pilot's findings and explains how the next survey will respond to the measurement problem.

explanationMd: The final paragraph notes sampling and seasonal limitations, then proposes a broader repeated survey. It places the results in context rather than treating the pilot as definitive.

distractorRationale.a: The paragraph explicitly preserves the role of roadside monitors.
distractorRationale.c: It identifies nonrandom selection as a limitation.
